title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Continuity Days on Prescriptions Relabel Remakes
content:
A relabel remake on a Kestrel Prescriptions record with few or no refills left carries the relabel continuity allowance.

## The rule the desk applies

The relabel continuity allowance looks at the refills left on the prescription, being the refills the prescriber authorized less the refills used by its refills plus the refills restored by returns to stock:

- **no refill left** (0 or fewer) gives **2 days**;
- **exactly one** refill left gives **1 day**;
- **more** refills left give no days.

Each allowance day adds the prescribed daily units — the prescription's written quantity divided by its written days supply — to the relabel remake quantity.

## Readings (hypothetical ledgers)

| Refills authorized | Used by refills | Restored by returns to stock | Refills left | Allowance days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 2 |
| 3 | 3 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| 3 | 1 | 0 | 2 | none |
